apps.name: Pigeon
apps.subtitle: Learn the routes you drive
apps.localizedDescription: Learn the routes you drive. Each clean drive of a saved route gives a little less help, from full directions to landmarks to a cue at each turn to silence, until you don't need it. Leave the route and full directions come back at once. Everything stays on your iPhone.

versions.localizedDescription: Merge claude/demo-drive: a demo drive shows every stage without driving
Merge claude/sidestore: SideStore builds from every push to main

apps.versionDescription: Merge claude/demo-drive: a demo drive shows every stage without driving

privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Pigeon uses your location to guide you along your saved routes and to notice when you leave one. Pigeon keeps your drives on this iPhone.
